blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: High-fidelity photovoltaic (PV) module mapping requires complete instance recovery and accurate delineation. Vision foundation models offer zero-shot segmentation, but converting incomplete and inconsistent predictions across views into a complete, geometrically accurate map of individual modules remains challenging. We propose the Multi-View PV Module Mapper (MV-PVMapper), a training-free framework coupling vision foundation models with unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) photogrammetry. First, Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) generates candidates from original images using text prompts. Their contours are then transferred into object space through per-module slope correction to limit distortion from surface-model noise, and verified against representative module dimensions to guide cross-view instance selection. Finally, accepted instances return to all covering images as box prompts for SAM~3, supplementing text prompts with spatial cues for iterative segmentation, verification and fusion. On five-direction surveys of three operational rooftop PV plants at approximately 1 cm nadir ground sampling distance, two feedback iterations recover 7,710 of 7,711 reference modules with no false positives at an intersection-over-union (IoU) matching threshold of 0.5. Macro-averaged area precision and recall reach 99.00 % and 98.52 %, respectively. Averaged across sites, the aggregated Jaccard index reaches 97.55 %, compared with 60.73 % and 41.24 % for orthomosaic segmentation and multi-view pixel-voting baselines, respectively; average precision at the stricter IoU threshold of 0.95 reaches 95.67 %. Ablation studies show that module-size constraints are critical for instance separation, while slope correction and feedback to all covering views improve boundary accuracy. These results are achieved without task-specific image annotation or segmentation-model weight updates.
blocks.zh: 高可靠性光伏(PV)模块绘图需要完整的实例恢复和准确的划界。 远景基础模型提供零射分解,但将不完全和不一致的跨观点预测转换成完整,几何准确的单个模块地图仍然具有挑战性. 我们提议采用多维光电模块映射仪(MV-PVMapper),这是一种无培训框架结合无人驾驶飞行器摄影测量的视觉基础模型。 首先,Sip Anything Model 3(SAM 3)利用文本提示从原始图像中生成候选人. 然后通过每个模块坡度校正将其轮廓转移到物体空间,以限制表面模型噪声的扭曲,并对照代表性模块尺寸进行校验,以指导交叉视图实例选择。 最后,被接受的事例作为SAM~3的框提示返回所有覆盖图像,用空间提示补充文本提示,用于迭代分割、核实和聚变。 在大约1厘米纳迪尔地面采样距离上对三个运行中的屋顶光电厂进行5个方向的勘测时,两次反馈迭代在7 711个参考单元中回收了7 710个,在0.5的交联比值下没有假阳性。 宏观平均面积精确度和召回率分别达到99.00 %和98.52%. 各地的Jaccard总指数平均达到97.55%,而整形分裂和多视像素投票基准分别为60.73%和41.24%;更严格的IoU阈值0.95的平均精度达到95.67%。 校正研究显示,模块大小限制是分离等关键因素,而坡度校正和反馈给所有覆盖观点则提高边界准确性。 这些成果是在没有任务特定图像注释或分区模型重量更新的情况下实现的.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The global energy transition is rapidly expanding the installed base of photovoltaic (PV) systems. By the end of 2025, global cumulative PV capacity had approached 3 TW, after an estimated 698 GW was installed in that year alone ( de l’Epine et al., 2026 ) . As the installed base grows, maintaining reliable performance over the lifetime of these assets requires inspection and maintenance at an increasingly large scale ( Gallardo-Saavedra et al., 2018 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Barraz et al., 2025a ) .
blocks.zh: 全球能源过渡正在迅速扩大光伏(光伏)系统的安装基础。 到2025年底,全球累计光电容量已接近3TW,仅当年就安装了约698GW(de l ' Epine等人,2026年)。 随着已安装基地的不断增长,在这些资产寿命期内保持可靠的性能,需要进行日益大规模的检查和维护(Gallardo-Saavedra等人,2018年;Chen等人,2023年;Barraz等人,2025a年)。

blocks.en: Within large PV installations, tasks such as targeted diagnosis, repair and replacement require inspection findings to be linked to individual modules and their locations. Module-level georeferencing supports this link between image-based inspection and field operations ( Barraz et al., 2025a ; Bommes et al., 2022 ) . A module map provides a common spatial representation in which each module has its own boundary and location. Its quality depends on recovering the module inventory while preserving the separation and geometry of individual instances, rather than only identifying the area occupied by PV arrays. Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) surveys can cover an entire plant efficiently, but converting UAV images into such a map remains difficult. Modules are densely and repeatedly arranged, their gaps may span only a few pixels, and their apparent scale and shape change under oblique viewing.
blocks.zh: 在大型光电装置中,如目标明确的诊断、修理和更换等任务需要检查结果与各个单元及其地点挂钩。 模块一级的地理参考支持基于图像的检查与实地业务之间的这种联系(Barraz等人,2025a); Bommes et al., 2022) (英语). 模块图提供了一个共同的空间代表,每个模块都有自己的边界和位置. 其质量取决于在恢复模块盘点的同时保留单个实例的分离和几何特征,而不仅仅是识别光电阵列占用的区域. 无人驾驶飞行器(UAV)的勘测可以高效地覆盖整个工厂,但将无人驾驶飞行器图像转换成这样的地图仍然很困难. 模块是密集和反复排列的,其间隙可能仅跨越几个像素,其明显的尺度和形状在斜视下变化.

blocks.en: PV module mapping involves both extracting individual instances and establishing their geographic locations. Rule-based methods can avoid labelled data, but depend on assumptions about colour, line structure, shape or array layout ( Wang et al., 2018 ; Cardoso et al., 2024 ) . Supervised detectors and segmentation networks can learn more flexible appearance features, but require annotated UAV images. Even domain-generalization methods rely on training data collected across different module types and imaging conditions to improve performance on unseen sites ( Barraz et al., 2024 ) . Beyond recognising and delineating modules, mapping also requires their image-space detections to be placed in a common geographic frame. Photogrammetry provides this spatial reference for UAV imagery. Structure-from-motion (SfM) estimates camera poses and reconstructs scene geometry, supporting both the georeferencing of modules detected in individual images and the generation of orthomosaics. These products support different mapping workflows: modules can be extracted from a georeferenced digital orthophoto map (DOM) ( Cardoso et al., 2024 ) , or observations in multiple images can be associated and located using the reconstructed geometry ( Bommes et al., 2022 ; Kozák et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 光电模块绘图涉及提取个别实例和确定其地理位置。 基于规则的方法可以避免标注数据,但取决于对颜色,行结构,形状或阵列布局的假设(Wang等人,2018年;Cardoso等人,2024年). 监督的探测器和分区网络可以学习更灵活的外观特征,但需要附加注释的无人机图像. 即使是域普及方法,也依靠不同模块类型和成像条件收集的培训数据,以提高隐蔽地点的性能(Barraz等人,2024年)。 除了识别和划定模块外,制图还需要将其图像空间探测置于共同的地理框架内。 摄影测量为无人机影像提供了这种空间参考. 结构-自动(SfM)估计相机提出并重建场景几何,既支持个人图像中检测到的模块的地理参照,又支持产生矫形. 这些产品支持不同的绘图工作流程:模块可以从一个地理参照数字正反光图(DOM)(Cardoso等人,2024年)中提取,或者多个图像中的观测可以使用重建的几何来连接和定位(Bommes等人,2022年;Kozák等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Promptable visual foundation models (VFMs) offer a way to reduce the annotation burden. The Segment Anything Model (SAM) supports zero-shot transfer to new image distributions and tasks through prompts ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) . SAM 3 further accepts concept prompts and can detect and segment instances named by a short noun phrase ( Carion et al., 2025 ) . Recent work has shown the potential of this training-free, open-vocabulary approach by formulating remote-sensing image interpretation as two-dimensional segmentation ( Li et al., 2025 ) . Within a photogrammetric workflow, the same model can be applied directly to a georeferenced DOM, so the predicted masks already have ground locations and physical extents. However, segmentation on a DOM uses a single orthorectified representation rather than explicitly combining predictions from the overlapping source images. For densely arranged PV modules, observations from different viewpoints can provide complementary evidence where individual views leave boundaries unclear.
blocks.zh: 快速视觉基础模型(VFMs)提供了一种减轻注释负担的方法. 片段 Anything Model(SAM)支持零镜头传输到新的图像分布和任务,通过提示(Kirillov等人,2023年). SAM 3进一步接受概念提示,并可以检测和分解以短名词短语命名的事件(Carion等人,2025年). 近期的工作表明,这种无培训、开放式的省票办法具有潜力,将遥感图像解释作为二维分解(Li等人,2025年)。 在一个摄影测量工作流程中,同样的模型可以直接应用到一个地理参照的DOM上,因此预测的面具已经具有地面位置和物理范围. 然而,DOM上的分割使用单一的正交代表,而不是明确结合重叠源图像的预测。 对于排列繁忙的光电模块,不同观点的观测可以提供补充证据,当个人观点使界限不明时。

blocks.en: A multi-view UAV oblique survey provides overlapping images that can observe the same module from several directions, while camera poses and a digital surface model (DSM) relate these observations within a common object-space frame. In addition, PV modules within a plant commonly follow one or a few standardized size specifications, allowing representative dimensions to be established from a small number of field measurements. Using these sources jointly for module mapping, however, raises two related challenges. The first is to transfer predictions reliably into object space despite noise in the reconstructed surface, which can distort their locations and shapes. The second is to combine predictions from views with different visibility and image quality, so that complementary observations reinforce one another while conflicting results are suppressed.
blocks.zh: 多视图UAV oblique调查提供了重叠的图像,可以从几个方向观测到同一个模块,而相机的姿势和数字表面模型(DSM)则在共同的物体-空间框架内将这些观测数据联系起来. 此外,工厂内的光电模块通常遵循一个或几个标准化尺寸规格,从而能够通过少量的实地测量确定代表性维度. 然而,联合利用这些来源进行模块绘图提出了两个相关的挑战。 第一个是将预测可靠地转移到物体空间,尽管重建的表面有噪音,这可以扭曲其位置和形状。 二是结合不同能见度和图像质量的视角预测,使互补观测相辅相成,同时抑制相互冲突的结果.

blocks.en: This study aims to achieve high-fidelity PV module mapping by combining zero-shot VFM segmentation with redundant observations from UAV photogrammetry, without task-specific training. We propose the Multi-View PV Module Mapper (MV-PVMapper), which links image-space segmentation and object-space geometric verification through iterative multi-view feedback. First, SAM 3 generates module candidates from the original images using a text concept prompt, without site-specific image annotation or segmentation-model weight updates. Second, per-module slope correction transfers candidate contours into object space while limiting deformation caused by DSM noise. Third, segmentation confidence and consistency with representative module dimensions guide cross-view fusion, retaining plausible module instances while suppressing conflicting and duplicate predictions. Finally, accepted object-space instances are projected into covering images as box prompts; the resulting masks are transferred back for geometric verification and fusion, providing updated spatial evidence for subsequent segmentation rounds. We evaluate MV-PVMapper on five-direction oblique photogrammetric data from three operational rooftop PV plants, with a nadir ground sampling distance (GSD) of approximately 1 cm/pixel. After two feedback iterations, MV-PVMapper matches 7 710 of the 7 711 reference modules across all three sites, with no false positives at an intersection-over-union (IoU) threshold of 0.5. It achieves macro-averaged area precision and recall of 99.00% and 98.52%, respectively. Its macro-averaged aggregated Jaccard index (AJI) and average precision at the stricter IoU threshold of 0.95 ( A ​ P 95 AP_{95} ) reach 97.55% and 95.67%, compared with 60.73% and 60.51% for an orthomosaic segmentation baseline (DOM-IterSeg), and 41.24% and 27.52% for a multi-view pixel-voting baseline (MV-PixelVote). Together, these results show near-complete instance recovery and accurate delineation on the evaluated sites, rather than high pixel precision alone.
blocks.zh: 本研究旨在通过将零射VFM分区与来自无人机摄影测量的冗余观测相结合,实现高纯度光电模块映射,而不进行任务特定训练. 我们建议使用多维光电模块映射仪(MV-PVMapper),通过迭代多视图反馈将图像-空间分区和物体-空间几何校验联系起来。 首先,SAM 3使用文本概念即时生成原始图像的模块候选人,没有特定站点的图像注释或分区-模型重量更新. 第二,每个模块坡度修正将候选轮廓转移至物体空间,同时限制DSM噪声引起的变形. 第三,分解信心和与代表性模块维度的一致性指导跨视聚变,保留可能存在的模块实例,同时抑制相互矛盾和重复的预测. 最后,被接受的物体-空间实例被投射到覆盖图像中,作为框提示;由此产生的面具被传送回进行几何校验和聚变,为随后的分解回合提供最新的空间证据. 我们从三个运行中的天台光电厂对MV-PVMapper进行五向斜摄影测量数据评价,地面取样距离约为1厘米/像素。 经过两次反馈迭代后,MV-PVMapper与所有三个站点的7 711个参考模块中的7 710个匹配,在0.5的交叉交叉(IoU)阈值上没有假阳性. 它实现了宏观平均面积的精确度,召回率分别为99.00 %和98.52%. 其宏观平均汇总的Jaccard指数(AJI)和在更严格的IoU阈值0.95(A P 95 AP_{95})上的平均精度达到97.55%和95.67%,而整形分裂基线(DOM-IterSeg)为60.73%和60.51%,多视像素投票基线(MV-PixelVote)为41.24%和27.52%。 这些结果加在一起表明,在被评价的场地上几乎完全恢复实例和准确划定,而不只是高度像素精确。

blocks.en: The main contributions are as follows: • We propose MV-PVMapper, a training-free framework that couples segmentation by a pretrained VFM with multi-view instance fusion in an iterative refinement loop for PV module mapping. By feeding geometrically verified instances back to all covering views as spatial prompts, the framework uses complementary observations to recover missed modules and refine their boundaries. • We introduce a per-module slope-correction strategy for projecting PV masks from image space to object space. By adapting the projection to each module’s local surface, it preserves module geometry and improves robustness to DSM noise. • We convert readily available module dimensions into an object-space geometry score that guides candidate selection, cross-view association and feedback. This geometry-guided strategy suppresses over- and under-segmentation and helps limit error accumulation across iterations.
blocks.zh: 主要贡献如下: 我们提议使用MV-PVMapper,这是一种无培训框架,夫妇通过经过预先训练的VFM进行分化,在PV模块映射的迭代完善循环中进行多视图实例聚变。 通过将经几何核实的实例反馈到所有覆盖视图中作为空间提示,该框架利用补充观测来恢复缺失的模块并完善其界限。 我们采用每个模块坡度校正策略,将光电罩从图像空间投射到物体空间。 通过使投影适应每个模块的局部表面,它保留了模块几何学,并提高了对DSM噪声的坚固度。 我们把现成的模块尺寸转换成物体空间几何分数,指导候选人的选择、交叉视图联系和反馈。 这种几何制导策略抑制了过度和不足的分层,并有助于限制跨迭代的错误积累.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: We review PV extraction methods, prompting strategies for VFMs, and multi-view fusion with geometric priors. The review distinguishes task-specific learning from training-free inference and examines how spatial evidence can support instance association and delineation, providing the context for MV-PVMapper.
blocks.zh: 我们审查光电萃取方法,促进VFM的策略,以及用几何前缀进行多视聚变. 审查将针对具体任务的学习与免费培训推论区分开来,并审查空间证据如何支持案例联系和划界,为MV-PV-Mapper提供背景。

blocks.en: 2.1 PV Module Extraction and Mapping
blocks.zh: 2.1 PV 提取和绘图模块

blocks.en: Image-based PV extraction supports applications ranging from installation inventories to component inspection ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Barraz et al., 2025a ) . Traditional methods identify panels through explicit appearance and geometric rules. Association between region and line primitives can support automatic template generation and matching without training samples ( Wang et al., 2018 ) . Edge detection, morphological processing and contour extraction provide another route to delineating individual panels ( Cardoso et al., 2024 ) . These methods make use of the regular appearance of PV installations, but their applicability depends on the chosen rules and thresholds. Changes in illumination, panel appearance or the visibility of narrow gaps can weaken the cues on which extraction relies.
blocks.zh: 基于图像的光电提取支持从安装清单到组件检查等各种应用(Chen等人,2023年;Barraz等人,2025年a). 传统方法通过明显的外观和几何规则来识别面板. 区域与线路原始人之间的关联可以支持自动模板生成和匹配而无需训练样本(Wang等人,2018年). 边缘探测、形态处理和轮廓提取是划定单个面板的另一种途径(Cardoso等人,2024年)。 这些方法利用光电装置的正常外观,但其适用性取决于选定的规则和阈值。 照明、面板外观或狭小差距的可见度的变化会削弱提取所依赖的提示。

blocks.en: Supervised learning replaces much of this manual feature design with representations learned from task data. For UAV thermal imagery, training across different module types and acquisition conditions has been used to improve generalisation to unseen installations ( Barraz et al., 2024 ) . Other approaches reduce the cost of adapting models to new data: weakly supervised domain adaptation transfers rooftop PV segmentation from densely labelled source imagery to target imagery with sparse point annotations ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , while parameter-efficient VFM adaptation has been explored for PV change detection ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . These developments address training-data diversity and annotation cost, but still require task-specific learning. Their practical deployment therefore still involves obtaining suitable training data and adapting the model.
blocks.zh: 监督学习用从任务数据中吸取的表示代替了这一手动特性设计的大部分. 就无人驾驶飞行器热成像而言,采用了不同舱型和获取条件的培训,以改善对隐形设施的普及(Barraz等人,2024年)。 其他办法减少了根据新数据调整模型的费用:在监管不力的情况下,将屋顶光电分解从高标签的源成像转移到标有稀有点说明的成像(Wang等人,2026年),同时探索了参数效率高的VFM变异探测(Huang等人,2026年)。 这些发展涉及培训数据的多样性和注释费用,但仍需要针对具体任务的学习。 因此,他们的实际部署仍然涉及获得适当的培训数据和调整模式。

blocks.en: 2.2 Prompting and Refinement with Visual Foundation Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 利用视觉基础模型进行提示和完善

blocks.en: SAM allows points, boxes and masks to specify the object to be segmented ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) . Evaluations on overhead imagery show useful zero-shot transfer, but also failures associated with the characteristics of remote-sensing targets ( Ren et al., 2024a ) . One response is to learn task-specific prompts or output representations. Category-aware prompt generation supports automatic instance segmentation ( Chen et al., 2024a ) , while automatic box prompting and a decoder trained to predict vertices and boundaries support polygonal building extraction ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . In PV imagery, learned multi-scale and edge-pyramid prompts incorporate scale and boundary information into SAM adaptation ( Yao et al., 2026 ) . These methods use the foundation model as a basis for task-specific learning.
blocks.zh: SAM允许点,框和口罩指定要分割的对象(Kirillov等人,2023年). 对俯仰图象的评价显示,零射线转移是有用的,但也与遥感目标的特点有关(Ren等人,2024a)。 一个对策是学习具体任务的提示或产出说明。 Category-aware 迅速生成支持自动实例分解(Chen等人,2024a),而自动箱提示和解码器则经过培训,可以预测顶点和边界,支持多边形建筑提取(Wang等人,2024年). 在光电成像中,学习到的多尺度和边缘金字塔提示将尺度和边界信息纳入SAM适应(Yao等人,2026年)。 这些方法使用基础模型作为特定任务学习的基础.

blocks.en: Language prompts offer a convenient way to specify a target category without placing a spatial prompt on each object. This can be implemented by coupling a text-conditioned detector with SAM ( Ren et al., 2024b ) , or through the unified concept-prompting interface of SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2025 ) . Direct application of SAM 3 to remote-sensing semantic segmentation has also been explored without additional training ( Li et al., 2025 ) . PV-specific vision–language pretraining offers a complementary approach: PANEL supports downstream zero- and few-shot interpretation after learning from a PV image–text corpus ( Deng et al., 2026 ) . MV-PVMapper instead uses a generic VFM without PV-specific training and coordinates its predictions across UAV views to recover georeferenced module instances.
blocks.zh: 语言提示提供了一种方便的方式来指定一个目标类别,而不在每个对象上设置一个空间提示. 这可以通过将文本条件检测器与SAM(Ren等人,2024年b)结合,或者通过SAM 3(Carion等人,2025年)的统一概念提示界面来实现. 还在没有额外培训的情况下探索了将SAM 3直接应用于遥感语义分区(Li等人,2025年)。 光电专用视觉-语言预训提供了一种补充方法:PANEL在学习光电图像-文本集(Deng et al., 2026)后,支持下游零镜头和几镜头的翻译。 MV-PVMapper使用通用的VFM而不进行光电专用训练,并协调其在无人驾驶飞行器观点上的预测,以恢复地理参照模块实例。

blocks.en: The prompt interface also supports refinement: previous masks and corrective prompts can be supplied in subsequent segmentation rounds ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) . The quality of this refinement depends on the evidence supplied to the model. In spatial mapping, observations from other views and geometric information provide possible sources of such evidence, alongside the prediction in the current image.
blocks.zh: 即时接口也支持精细化:先前的口罩和纠正提示可以在后续的分块回合中提供(Kirillov等人,2023年). 这种改进的质量取决于向模型提供的证据。 在空间测绘方面,来自其他观点的观测和几何信息提供了可能的证据来源,同时也提供了当前图像中的预测。

blocks.en: 2.3 Multi-view Fusion and Geometric Priors
blocks.zh: 2.3 多视融合和几何前身

blocks.en: Photogrammetric geometry allows observations from different images to be compared in a common spatial frame. In PV mapping, detections have been georeferenced through tracking and SfM, or associated across images using semantic keypoints and plant structure ( Bommes et al., 2022 ; Kozák et al., 2026 ) . Learned fusion also uses this spatial correspondence to combine information before prediction. Image features can be backprojected and pooled on a voxel grid together with geometric features ( Dai and Nießner, 2018 ) , or aggregated on 3D points with weights learned from viewing conditions ( Robert et al., 2022 ) . For aerial building mapping, MVMapper combines original-image and object-space features using supervised learning and piecewise affine projection to reduce DSM-induced misalignment ( Chen et al., 2024b ) . MV-PVMapper shares MVMapper’s use of a common spatial frame to exploit complementary aerial observations, but operates on predicted module instances rather than learned feature fusion. Geometric verification and cross-view feedback coordinate these instances while the segmentation model remains frozen.
blocks.zh: 摄影测量几何可以使不同图像的观测在共同的空间框架内进行比较. 在光电映射中,通过跟踪和SfM对探测进行了地理参照,或者利用语义键点和植物结构在图像之间进行了关联(Bommes等人,2022年;Kozák等人,2026年)。 学到的聚变还利用这种空间对应,在预测前结合信息. 图像特征可以反向投影并集合在带有几何特征的阴道网格上(Dai和Nießner,2018年),也可以汇总在3D点上,从取景条件中汲取了权重(Robert等人,2022年). 对于空中建筑测绘,MVMapper将原创图像和物体空间特征结合起来,利用有监督的学习和片面的近缘投影以减少DSM引起的错配(Chen等人,2024b). MV-PVMapper分享MVMapper使用共同的空间框架来利用互补的空中观测,但运行在预测的模块实例上,而不是学习到的特征聚变. 几何校验和交叉视图反馈协调了这些实例,而分区模型仍然冻结。

blocks.en: At the instance level, fusion must distinguish repeated detections from neighbouring objects. Non-maximum suppression (NMS) ranks candidates and removes those with excessive overlap; Soft-NMS instead reduces their scores according to overlap ( Bodla et al., 2017 ) . For multi-view masks, the evidence can extend beyond pairwise overlap. Consistency with masks from several views can guide the merging of 3D regions ( Yin et al., 2024 ) , and agreement among views can define graph connections for clustering masks into instances ( Yan et al., 2024 ) . Spatial information can also guide segmentation itself: SAMPro3D projects shared 3D prompts into images and selects and consolidates them using multi-view mask evidence, without additional training ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . Thus, geometric information can support both instance association and prompt selection.
blocks.zh: 在实例层面,聚变必须区分重复探测和相邻物体. 非最大压制(NMS)对候选人进行排名,并删除那些重叠过多的人;Soft-NMS转而根据重叠减少他们的分数(Bodla等人,2017年). 对于多视图口罩,证据可以延伸超过对偶重叠. 与来自多个观点的口罩保持一致可以指导3D区域(Yin等人,2024年)的合并,意见之间的一致可以定义将口罩组合成实例的图表连接(Yan等人,2024年). 空间信息也可以指导分区化本身:SAMPro3D项目共享3D提示输入图像,并使用多视图遮罩证据进行选择和整合,无需额外培训(徐等人,2025年). 因此,几何信息可以支持实例关联和即时选择。

blocks.en: Module dimensions and regular layouts provide constraints beyond visual appearance. In PV applications, physical module dimensions have been used to generate training boxes automatically ( Barraz et al., 2025b ) . Detected templates and layout constraints can also guide the completion of module maps ( Cardoso et al., 2024 ) . Such priors can complement VFMs: SinkSAM-Net uses topographic depressions to generate prompts and shape information to filter SAM masks before training a downstream segmenter ( Rafaeli et al., 2025 ) . MV-PVMapper uses representative dimensions to verify object-space candidates and select instances for mapping and subsequent spatial prompting.
blocks.zh: 模块尺寸和常规布局提供了超出视觉外观的限制. 在光电池应用中,物理模块尺寸被用于自动生成培训箱(Barraz等人,2025年b)。 检测到的模板和布局限制也可指导模块地图的完成(Cardoso等人,2024年)。 这些前科可以补充VFM:SinkSAM-Net使用地形低压生成提示和形状信息,在培训下游分机前过滤SAM口罩(Rafaeri等人,2025年). MV-PVMapper使用代表性维度来验证对象-空间候选,并选择绘图和随后空间提示的实例.

blocks.en: 3 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3 个数据集

blocks.en: We constructed a UAV oblique photogrammetric dataset of three operational rooftop PV plants. For each plant, it contains image-space data, namely the original nadir and oblique images, and object-space data, namely the camera poses, DSM and DOM reconstructed from these images, together with a reference polygon for every module.
blocks.zh: 我们建造了一个无人驾驶飞行器斜面摄影测量数据集,由三个运行中的屋顶光电厂组成。 对于每个厂房,它都包含图像空间数据,即原始的nadir和oblique图像,以及物体空间数据,即相机的姿势,DSM和DOM从这些图像中重建,以及每个模块的参考多边形.

blocks.en: 4 Methods
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: MV-PVMapper takes overlapping UAV images, calibrated camera poses, a georeferenced DSM and representative module dimensions as inputs, and outputs a map of separate, georeferenced module polygons (Figure 2 ). It alternates between prompted segmentation in image space and geometric verification and fusion in object space. Per-module slope correction transfers candidate contours to a common spatial frame, where segmentation confidence and module geometry guide cross-view instance selection. The accepted instances return to the covering images as box prompts for further segmentation. The final module map is the accepted instance set from the last fusion round.
blocks.zh: MV-PVMapper拍摄了重叠的无人驾驶航空器图像,校准相机的姿势,一个地理参照DSM和代表性模块维度作为输入,并输出一个单独的地理参照模块多边形的地图(图2). 它在图像空间的激发区段与物体空间的几何校验和聚变之间取而代之。 每个模块坡度校正将候选轮廓转移至一个共同的空间框架,其中分区置信度和模块几何学指导交叉视图实例选择. 已接受的示例返回封面图像作为框提示,以进一步分割。 最后的模块映射是最后一个聚变回合中接受的实例集.

blocks.en: 4.1 View-Wise Prompted Segmentation
blocks.zh: 4.1 视图宽度提示分割

blocks.en: Iterative segmentation requires prompts that can evolve as spatial evidence becomes available. A text prompt identifies the target category and provides initial candidates without known module locations. Once reliable instances have been identified, box prompts add location cues that a repeated category description alone cannot provide. The segmentation model must therefore accept text and box prompts and return instance masks with confidence scores. We use SAM 3, whose concept-prompting and interactive segmentation capabilities support these requirements ( Carion et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 迭代分化需要随空间证据的出现而演变的提示. 一个文本提示可以识别目标类别,并提供没有已知模块位置的初始候选人. 一旦找到可靠的实例,框提示会添加仅重复的类别描述无法提供的位置提示。 因此,分解模式必须接受文字和框式提示和带有信任分数的返回实例口罩。 我们使用SAM 3,其概念促动和交互分割能力支持这些要求(Carion等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: For the initial pass, SAM 3 is queried with the text prompt a PV panel . Inference uses overlapping windows to preserve the narrow gaps between neighbouring modules, which may become difficult to resolve if an entire UAV image is resized to the model input. The last row and column of windows are aligned with the image boundary, and the predicted masks are restored to the original image coordinates using the window offsets. Candidates below the confidence or mask-area threshold are discarded.
blocks.zh: 对于最初的通行证, SAM 3 被询问, 文本提示一个PV面板。 推论使用重叠窗口来维护相邻模块之间的狭小差距,如果将整个无人机图像调整为模型输入,则可能难以解决. 窗口的最后一行和一列与图像边界对齐,预测的口罩利用窗口的偏移恢复到原始图像坐标. 低于置信度或遮罩区阈值的候选人会被丢弃.

blocks.en: In subsequent rounds, accepted object-space instances are projected back into the covering images to generate box prompts (Section 4.4 ). By conveying module locations established from other views, these box prompts guide the re-segmentation of modules previously missed or poorly delineated in the target image. Each box is clipped to every window it intersects. For each window, all available box prompts are used unless their number exceeds N b N_{b} , in which case N b N_{b} prompts are randomly selected. Windows with box prompts use both spatial and text prompts, whereas windows without box prompts use text-only inference. Duplicates from overlapping windows are retained until object-space fusion, where they are resolved together with cross-view duplicates (Section 4.3 ). Numerical settings are given in Section 5.1 .
blocks.zh: 在随后的回合中,被接受的物体-空间实例被投射回封面图像中以生成框提示(第4.4节)。 通过传送从其他视图中建立的模块位置,这些框提示指导了以前在目标图像中遗漏或描述不当的模块的重新划分. 每个盒子被剪切到它交叉的每一个窗口. 对于每个窗口,都会使用所有可用的框提示,除非其数量超过 N b NQQB},在这种情况下,N b NQQB}提示会被随机选择. 带有框提示的Windows同时使用空间提示和文本提示,而没有框提示的窗口则使用文本唯一的推论. 重叠窗口的复制件保留到物体空间聚变时再与交叉视图复制件一起解决(第4.3节)。 第5.1节给出了数字设置。

blocks.en: 4.2 Per-Module Slope Correction Using DSM
blocks.zh: 4.2 使用DSM的每个模块斜坡校正

blocks.en: Photogrammetric DSMs can smooth sharp height discontinuities at object edges. Intersecting each contour vertex’s viewing ray with such a surface can therefore displace or distort an otherwise accurate image-space contour ( Chen et al., 2024b ) . In dense PV arrays, these errors affect module edges and the narrow gaps between rows.
blocks.zh: 摄影测量 DSM在物体边缘可以平滑尖端高度不连续. 因此,将每个顶点的视线与这样的表面相交可以取代或扭曲本来准确的图像空间轮廓(Chen等人,2024年b)。 在密集的光电阵列中,这些错误会影响模块边缘和行之间的狭长差距.

blocks.en: We introduce a per-module slope-correction strategy that uses the approximately planar module surface to project PV mask contours into object space. For each mask, a z-buffer identifies visible DSM points that fall within the mask when projected into the image. We then fit a local plane to these points using random sample consensus (RANSAC) ( Fischler and Bolles, 1981 ) , reducing the influence of outliers near module edges or on surrounding surfaces. Candidates are excluded if the fitted plane is insufficiently supported by the points or has an implausibly steep slope. For each retained candidate, the camera pose and interior orientation define a viewing ray through each mask-contour vertex. We intersect these rays with the fitted plane and use the planimetric coordinates of the intersections to construct the object-space polygon. The contour is thus transferred using a common local plane, rather than independent intersections with the DSM, preserving straight edges without imposing a rectangular shape. Whether the resulting polygon corresponds to one physical module is assessed in Section 4.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们采用了每个模块的坡度校正策略,利用大约平面的平面模块将光电罩轮廓投射到物体空间。 对于每个面具,一个z-缓冲器识别出投射到图像时属于面具内的可见DSM点. 然后,我们利用随机抽样共识(RANSAC)(Fischler和Bolles,1981年)使局部平面适应这些点,减少舱边附近或周围表面的舱外效应。 如果配备的飞机没有得到充分的分数支持,或坡度不高,则不考虑候选人。 对于每个保留候选人,相机姿势和内置方向定义了穿过每个面具-层层顶点的视线. 我们将这些射线与安装的平面相交,并使用交叉点的浮游坐标来构建物体-空间多边形. 轮廓因此使用一个共同的局部平面进行转移,而不是与DSM的独立交汇,在不强加长方形的情况下保留直缘. 第4.3节评估所产生的多边形是否相当于一个物理模块。

blocks.en: Figure 3 illustrates the effect of the local surface model. Collinearity-based projection transfers local height errors to the contour vertices and can bend edges across module gaps. A two-dimensional image-to-object affine transformation ( Chen et al., 2024b ) preserves straight edges, but DSM points from the surrounding roof can bias the estimated affine parameters. Slope correction projection instead uses RANSAC to fit the surface from visible DSM points that project into the mask, giving closer agreement with the module boundaries in this example.

blocks.en: 4.3 Geometry-Guided Scoring and Cross-View Fusion
blocks.zh: 4.3 几何定向分红和交叉视差

blocks.en: After slope correction, candidates from all images share one object-space coordinate system. Some still represent module fragments or merged groups, while others are repeated observations of the same module. We score their geometric plausibility before using NMS to select representative instances across views.
blocks.zh: 坡度修正后,来自所有图像的候选人共享一个对象-空间坐标系统. 有些仍然是模块碎片或合并组,而另一些则是对同一模块的重复观测。 在使用NMS来选择不同角度的代表性实例之前,我们先得分他们的几何可信度。

blocks.en: Rooftop PV arrays often use repeated module specifications and regular installation patterns. Representative dimensions can be obtained by measuring a module or consulting its product specification, providing a low-cost indication of the expected size of one instance. We use these dimensions as a soft constraint, not a requirement that every module have exactly the same size. The evaluated sites contain modest dimensional variation, which is accommodated through a tolerance in the score.
blocks.zh: 屋顶光电阵列经常使用重复的模块规格和常规安装模式. 可通过衡量一个模块或参考其产品规格,以低成本表示一个实例的预期规模,获得代表性维度。 我们将这些维度用作软约束,而不是要求每个模块的大小完全相同。 被评价的站点含有微小的维度差异,通过分数的容忍度来适应.

blocks.en: The iteration index t t counts feedback rounds, with t = 0 t=0 denoting the initial text-only pass. Segmentation, slope correction, scoring and fusion yield the accepted instance set for that round. Although each retained polygon originates from one image, its role is not confined to that source view: it is projected into every image whose ground footprint intersects the instance. blocks.en: The evaluation examines whether MV-PVMapper produces a complete module map with separate, geometrically consistent instances. blocks.en: 5.2 Evaluation Metrics and Baseline Design
blocks.zh: 5.2 评价计量和基线设计

blocks.en: All methods are evaluated as georeferenced polygons in the same object-space coordinate system. We assess PV coverage first and individual module instances second. Metrics are computed separately for each site; overall results are unweighted averages of the three site-level values, reported as percentages to two decimal places.

blocks.en: 5.2.1 Area-Level Agreement
blocks.zh: 5.2.1 地区级协定

blocks.en: Area-level evaluation follows the foreground-overlap principle used in semantic segmentation ( Long et al., 2015 ) . Predicted polygons are merged into one coverage region, and reference polygons into another, without retaining instance identities. Area IoU is their intersection area divided by their union area. Area precision is the fraction of predicted coverage supported by the reference, area recall is the fraction of reference coverage recovered, and area F 1 F_{1} is their harmonic mean. These metrics assess coverage but do not distinguish boundaries between neighbouring modules.

blocks.en: 5.2.3 Baseline Design
blocks.zh: 5.2.3 基线设计

blocks.en: The comparison tests two alternative mapping strategies while retaining SAM 3 as the segmentation model. The baselines adapt established processing ideas to the present training-free setting; they are not reproductions of the cited systems or direct comparisons with those papers’ published results.
blocks.zh: 比较试验了两种备选绘图战略,同时保留了SAM 3作为分区模型. 基线使既定的处理想法适应目前的无培训环境;它们不是所引用系统的复制,也不是与这些论文公布的结果的直接比较。

blocks.en: • DOM-IterSeg: iterative segmentation on an orthophoto. Extracting modules from a georeferenced orthomosaic is an established PV mapping route ( Cardoso et al., 2024 ) . We implement it with iterative SAM 3 segmentation and the module-geometry prior on each site’s DOM. This baseline tests how far prompted segmentation and geometric screening can proceed within one orthorectified representation, without cross-view feedback from the source images. • MV-PixelVote: multi-view pixel-level decision fusion. Projection-based semantic mapping can combine predictions from multiple views at shared spatial locations ( Lawin et al., 2017 ) . We adapt this decision-fusion idea by segmenting the same perspective images used by MV-PVMapper, transferring their masks to object space and combining them by pixel-level voting. Voting thresholds are tuned separately for each site. This baseline uses multi-view evidence but aggregates foreground support at individual pixels rather than selecting module instances using their geometry.
blocks.zh: • DOM-IterSeg:在正反相片上进行迭代分割。 从一个地理参照正统图中提取模块是一种既定的光电绘图路线(Cardoso等人,2024年)。 我们用迭代的 SAM 3 分区和模块几何来实施它。 这种基线测试了诱导分解和几何筛选在一次正交代表中可以进行到什么程度,而没有源图像的交叉视图反馈. • MV-PixelVote:多视像素级决定聚变. 基于投影的语义映射可以结合来自共享空间位置的多种观点的预测(Lawin等人,2017年). 我们通过将MV-PVMapper所用的同样视角图像分解,将面具转移到物体空间,并通过像素级的投票将其组合起来,来适应这个决策融合的想法. 每个地点的投票门槛分别调整。 这个基线使用多视图证据,但在单个像素上集合前景支持,而不是使用它们的几何来选择模块实例.

blocks.en: DOM-IterSeg: iterative segmentation on an orthophoto. Extracting modules from a georeferenced orthomosaic is an established PV mapping route ( Cardoso et al., 2024 ) . We implement it with iterative SAM 3 segmentation and the module-geometry prior on each site’s DOM. This baseline tests how far prompted segmentation and geometric screening can proceed within one orthorectified representation, without cross-view feedback from the source images.

We adapt this decision-fusion idea by segmenting the same perspective images used by MV-PVMapper, transferring their masks to object space and combining them by pixel-level voting. Voting thresholds are tuned separately for each site. This baseline uses multi-view evidence but aggregates foreground support at individual pixels rather than selecting module instances using their geometry.

blocks.en: MV-PVMapper uses the original perspective images, camera geometry and DSM; it does not use the DOM as a segmentation input. Thus, DOM-IterSeg assesses the orthophoto route, whereas MV-PixelVote assesses pixel-level aggregation of the original multi-view predictions. All three methods run two feedback rounds after the initial text-only pass and are compared at t = 2 t=2 . In each feedback round, DOM-IterSeg uses the bounding boxes of the previous round’s polygons, converted to DOM pixel coordinates, as box prompts. MV-PixelVote counts the projected polygons covering each cell of a 0.02 m object-space grid. Cells with at least 20, 27 and 30 votes at Sites 1, 2 and 3, respectively, are retained, and their connected components are converted to polygons. Polygons smaller than 0.6 m 2 are removed.

MV- 像素 投票计算覆盖一个0.02米物体-空间网格每个单元格的预测多边形。 在Site 1, 2和3上分别拥有至少20,27和30票的单元格被保留,其连接的组件被转换成多边形. 小于0.6米2的多边形被移除.

blocks.en: • Collinearity-based projection: intersect each contour vertex’s viewing ray directly with the DSM. • Affine-based projection: fit a two-dimensional affine transformation from DSM-derived image–object correspondences within each candidate’s image bounding box. This adapts the affine-mapping idea of MVMapper ( Chen et al., 2024b ) to individual candidates. • Slope correction projection (ours): fit a local module plane from visible DSM points that project into the mask and intersect the contour rays with that plane.

blocks.en: 5.4.2 Module-Geometry Prior

blocks.en: This experiment separates the roles of size and shape in deciding whether a candidate represents one module. The four configurations are:
blocks.zh: 这个实验在决定一个候选人是否代表一个模块时将大小和形状的作用分开. 这四个配置是:

blocks.en: • No geometry prior: use segmentation confidence without the area or rectangularity term. • Rectangularity only (+ rect): retain the rectangularity term but remove the area term. • Area only (+ area): retain the area term but remove the rectangularity term. • Full prior (+ rect + area; ours): combine both terms as in MV-PVMapper.
blocks.zh: • 支助 没有几何学前:在没有区域或长方形术语的情况下使用分区置信度. • 仅矩形(+矩形):保留矩形名词,但删除区域名词. • 仅限面积(+面积):保留面积术语,但删除矩形术语。 • 完全前置(+矩+面积;我们的):将MV-PVMapper中的两种术语合并。

blocks.en: No geometry prior: use segmentation confidence without the area or rectangularity term.
blocks.zh: 没有几何学前:在没有区域或长方形术语的情况下使用分区置信度.

blocks.en: Rectangularity only (+ rect): retain the rectangularity term but remove the area term.
blocks.zh: 只矩形(+矩形):保留矩形名词,但删除区域名词.

blocks.en: Area only (+ area): retain the area term but remove the rectangularity term.
blocks.zh: 仅限面积(+面积):保留区域名词,但去掉长方形名词.

blocks.en: Full prior (+ rect + area; ours): combine both terms as in MV-PVMapper.
blocks.zh: 完全前置(+矩形+区域;我们的):将MV-PVMapper中的两种术语合并.

The area term supplies the missing instance-scale constraint: on its own, it restores RQ to 99.95%. Combining it with rectangularity further improves A ​ P 95 AP_{95} from 90.81% to 95.67%. blocks.en: The two terms therefore have distinct roles. Area is central to recovering the correct module inventory, while rectangularity improves the selection of well-delineated candidates at the expected scale. Neither strong coverage metrics nor the quality of matched pairs alone adequately describes the failures observed when these constraints are removed.

blocks.en: 5.4.3 Feedback Routing
blocks.zh: 5.4.3 反馈程序

blocks.en: This experiment asks whether feedback benefits from cross-view evidence, rather than simply from repeated model calls. We compare four ways of generating and routing prompts:
blocks.zh: 这一实验询问反馈是否从交叉视图证据中受益,而不是简单地从重复的模型调用中受益. 我们比较了四种生成和路径提示的方法:

blocks.en: • No feedback: retain the initial text-only result at t = 0 t=0 . • Image-space self re-prompting: derive each image’s boxes from its own predictions in the previous round, without using the fused object-space result. • Source-view routing: return each accepted object-space instance only to the image that supplied its representative polygon. • Covering-view routing (ours): return each accepted object-space instance to all images that cover its location.

blocks.en: 5.6 Implications, Applicability and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5.6 影响、适用和限制

blocks.en: On the three evaluated rooftop plants, a frozen VFM combined with photogrammetric geometry and limited dimensional information produces a nearly complete module inventory with accurate boundaries. The geometry prior does not replace image interpretation; it helps select candidates at the scale of one physical module, while covering-view feedback allows reliable observations to improve other views. The resulting georeferenced instances provide the spatial objects needed to associate inspection findings with individual assets. Here, training-free means that no task-specific model training or weight updates are performed; it does not mean that the method requires no site information.
blocks.zh: 在三个受评价的屋顶工厂,一个冷冻的VFM与摄影测量几何和有限的维度信息相结合,产生了一个几乎完整的、有准确边界的模块清单。 前几何不取代图像解析;它帮助选择一个物理模块尺度的候选者,而覆盖-视图反馈则允许可靠的观察来改进其他视图. 由此产生的地理参照实例提供了将检查结果与个别资产联系起来所需的空间物体。 在此,无培训意味着不进行具体任务模式培训或重量更新;并不意味着该方法不需要站点信息。

blocks.en: The input requirement also defines the scope of deployment. MV-PVMapper is designed for overlapping oblique UAV imagery with reconstructed camera poses and a DSM, rather than an isolated image or an orthophoto alone. Photogrammetric reconstruction is already used in UAV-based PV mapping and inspection workflows ( Bommes et al., 2022 ; Cardoso et al., 2024 ) . Where such a survey is available, the method reuses the redundant source observations and reconstructed geometry; its additional site-specific input is a representative module size. The acquisition and reconstruction effort remains necessary where these data do not yet exist. Each feedback round processes every sliding window again, making the present implementation more suitable for offline map generation than real-time inspection.
blocks.zh: 投入要求还确定了部署范围。 MV-PVMapper是为重叠的紫外线图像设计的,带有重建的相机姿势和DSM,而不是单独一个孤立的图像或正反光. 摄影测量重建已经在基于无人驾驶航空器的光电绘图和检查工作流程中使用(Bommes等人,2022年;Cardoso等人,2024年)。 在有这种调查的情况下,该方法重新利用冗余源观测和重构几何;其针对具体地点的额外输入是具有代表性的模块大小。 在尚无这些数据的情况下,仍有必要进行获取和重建工作。 每个反馈回合都会再次处理每个滑动窗口,使得目前的执行更适合线下地图生成,而不是实时检查.

blocks.en: The evaluated sites do not cover rooftops with highly irregular installations and several substantially different module specifications. A single representative size may then reject valid modules or admit fragments of larger ones. Lower image resolution, severe occlusion and larger installation tilts also require further evaluation.
blocks.zh: 所评估的地点没有覆盖屋顶,安装高度不规则,几个模块规格大不相同。 单一的代表性尺寸可拒绝有效的模块,或接受较大的模块碎片。 图像分辨率较低、严重隐蔽和安装倾斜也需要进一步评价。

blocks.en: We use SAM 3 as a representative model with the required prompting interface rather than compare a large set of segmentation backbones. The present experiments isolate the contribution of photogrammetric coordination while holding the backbone fixed. Near-complete recovery on these sites leaves limited scope for distinguishing models by instance count alone. Later or alternative promptable models may still improve boundary accuracy or reduce inference cost.
blocks.zh: 我们使用SAM 3作为具有所需提示接口的代表性模型,而不是比较一大组分块主干线. 目前的实验在固定主干时隔离了摄影测量协调的贡献. 这些地点接近完全恢复,仅按个案计算就难以区分模型。 后期或可替代的快速模型仍可能提高边界准确性或降低推论成本.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This study presents MV-PVMapper, a training-free framework for extracting georeferenced PV module instances from UAV multi-view images. It connects prompt-driven SAM 3 segmentation with object-space geometric verification and returns the fused modules to covering views as spatial prompts. Per-module slope correction transfers image contours through a locally coherent DSM surface, while the module-geometry score guides candidate selection, cross-view association and feedback. The resulting workflow links the complementary observations of a photogrammetric survey to a common module map without updating the segmentation-model weights.
blocks.zh: 本研究介绍了MV-PVMapper,这是从无人机多视图图像中提取地理参考光电模块实例的无培训框架。 它将快速驱动的SAM 3分区与物体-空间几何校验连接起来,并将引信模块返回到覆盖视图的空间提示中. 每个模块坡度校正通过一个当地一致的DSM表面传输图像轮廓,而模块-几何分数则指导候选人选择,交叉视图关联和反馈. 由此产生的工作流程将摄影测量调查的补充观测结果与共同模块地图联系起来,而不更新分区模型加权数。

blocks.en: On three rooftop plants containing 7 711 reference modules, two feedback iterations produce 7 710 matched instances with no false positives and one false negative. The framework achieves a macro-averaged AJI of 97.55% and an A ​ P 95 AP_{95} of 95.67%, compared with 60.73% and 60.51% for DOM-IterSeg and 41.24% and 27.52% for MV-PixelVote. The ablations support the combined roles of covering-view feedback, local surface correction and geometric screening. These findings indicate that a pretrained image model can support module-level mapping when its predictions are assessed and coordinated using photogrammetric geometry.
blocks.zh: 在3个屋顶厂房中,有7 711个参考单元,两个反馈迭代产生7 710个匹配实例,没有假阳性,有一个假阴性。 该框架实现宏观平均AJI为97.55%,AP95 AP_{95}95.67%,而DOM-IterSeg为60.73%和60.51%,MV-PixelVote为41.24%和27.52%。 缩写支持覆盖视图反馈、局部地表校正和几何筛选的综合作用。 这些调查结果表明,一个经过预先训练的图像模型在使用摄影测量几何来评估和协调其预测时,可以支持模块级绘图.
